# zest

> zest is a free, open-source (MIT) autocomplete popup for zsh on macOS. While you type a command it shows subcommands, options, git branches, files and history, each with a description, in a popup right under the text cursor in Terminal.app, iTerm2, Ghostty, VS Code and Cursor. It is a native Swift menu bar app and an alternative to the autocomplete in Fig, Amazon Q and Kiro CLI.

Facts:

- Requirements: macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon, zsh. bash, fish and Intel Macs are not supported.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rostik32/zest/main/install.sh | sh`, or `brew tap rostik32/tap && brew trust rostik32/tap && brew install --cask zest`.
- Ships with specs for 1,500 commands (git, docker, kubectl, npm, brew, aws, gcloud, …) converted from the open-source Fig spec collection.
- A new command is one YAML file in `~/.config/zest/specs`; `zest gen <command>` drafts it from `--help`, `zest validate` checks it.
- Themes: 74 bundled VS Code themes, a light/dark pair that follows macOS, the current VS Code or Cursor theme, or any VS Code theme imported with `zest theme import`. Font, size, rows and width are configurable.
- Runs locally; the only network request is the GitHub update check, which can be turned off.
- Uses about 20–30 MB of memory. zsh talks to the app over a Unix socket; there is no terminal proxy.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rostik32/zest/main/README.md): install, keys, settings, FAQ
- [Adding a command](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rostik32/zest/main/docs/adding-a-command.md): writing a spec step by step
- [Spec format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rostik32/zest/main/docs/spec-format.md): every field of the YAML spec
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rostik32/zest/main/docs/architecture.md): how the zsh script, the socket and the app work together
- [Themes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rostik32/zest/main/docs/themes.md): theme files, importing VS Code themes
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rostik32/zest/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): building, testing and sending pull requests
